issues.pattern: Insecure deserialization: yaml.load() with an unsafe Loader
issues.explanation: Untrusted data is passed to an insecure deserializer (pickle, marshal, dill, jsonpickle, joblib, yaml.load without a safe Loader, or torch.load without weights_only). These deserializers reconstruct arbitrary objects and invoke callables during loading, so deserializing attacker-controlled bytes is equivalent to arbitrary code execution.
issues.remediation: Never deserialize untrusted input with pickle/marshal/dill/jsonpickle/joblib. Use a data-only format such as JSON. For YAML use yaml.safe_load; for PyTorch use torch.load(..., weights_only=True); for numpy avoid allow_pickle=True. If a binary format is unavoidable, verify an HMAC/signature over the bytes before loading.
